meta.status: assumption, not measured: percentages are risk factors, not observed losses
meta.rain_source: Founder's recorded daily rain 2024-01-01 to 2025-09-30 (station not stated)
meta.rain_source_note: Recorded daily rainfall supplied by the founder; station and units as in his workbook (mm per day).

inputs.name: area_ha
inputs.note: Block area (used for the per-hectare figure)

assumptions.rule: total rain in D+1..D+4 is more than 50 mm
assumptions.basis: Runoff/leaching potential very high after >50 mm in D+1..D+4

assumptions.rule: total rain in D+1..D+3 is more than 35 mm
assumptions.basis: Leaching and runoff potential increases after >35 mm in D+1..D+3

assumptions.rule: no day in D+1..D+3 has effective rain (at least 5.0 mm)
assumptions.basis: Fertiliser does not dissolve at once; nitrogen volatilisation risk when there is no effective rain for 3-5 days

assumptions.rule: a day in D+1..D+2 has 5 to 13 mm
assumptions.basis: 5-13 mm within 1-2 days helps dissolving and early infiltration

assumptions.rule: none of the rows above applies
assumptions.basis: The chapter's table has no row for this rain pattern; no risk value is claimed

headline.text_en: If you apply on 05 Nov 2024, about Rp21,206,250 of fertiliser value is at risk (15% assumed for 'very high rain risk'). Moving to 06 Nov 2024 and following the daily forecast, the assumed residual risk is Rp4,241,250. Difference: Rp16,965,000 (Rp565,500 per ha). A risk estimate from the founder's assumptions, not a proven loss. Caution: the suggested day is still 'high rain risk' (10% assumed); using only the table's own factors the difference is Rp7,068,750.
headline.text_id: Jika dipupuk pada 05-11-2024, sekitar Rp21.206.250 nilai pupuk berisiko (15% asumsi untuk 'Risiko sangat tinggi (hujan sangat tinggi)'). Dengan pindah ke 06-11-2024 dan mengikuti prakiraan harian, residual risk diasumsikan Rp4.241.250. Selisih: Rp16.965.000 (Rp565.500/ha). Estimasi risiko berdasarkan asumsi pendiri, bukan kerugian yang terbukti. Catatan: hari yang disarankan masih 'Risiko tinggi (hujan tinggi)' (10% asumsi); dengan faktor tabel saja selisihnya Rp7.068.750.

scale.note: One application of one block. Application frequency, fertiliser type, topography, soil texture, ground cover and application method are not modelled.

limitations: The percentages are the founder's assumptions (risk factors from his chapter), not measured losses: this is a RISK of loss in value terms, never a proven loss.
One application of one block. Application frequency, fertiliser type, topography, soil texture, ground cover and application method are not modelled.
Rain is gridded (Open-Meteo) or a recorded series of unknown station; the daily forecast beyond a few days is uncertain, which is what the residual factor stands for.
Rain patterns not covered by the founder's table (for example 14 to 35 mm) are 'not classified': no risk value is claimed for them.
The class rules (sum over the window, a 3-day dry window, a day of 5-13 mm for 'safe') are one reading of the chapter and can be changed in config/fertiliser_timing.yaml.
Scaling to a larger area repeats the block's figure per hectare; it is not an estate forecast.
